events.title: Sephardic Heritage Shabbat at Shirat Hayam
events.description: Join Congregation Shirat Hayam for a Sephardic Heritage Shabbat featuring guest musician Yoni Battat. Friday: Holy Happy Hour at 5:30 PM, spirited musical Shabbat service at 6 PM, followed by Shabbat dinner (RSVP required; $36 members / $42 nonmembers). Saturday: Renewal Service at 9:30 AM with Yoni Battat accompanying Rabbi Michael and Cantor Sarah; Torah Service at 10:30 AM featuring Yoni chanting the first Aliyah in Mizrahi nusach; Sephardi 101 at 10:45 AM with Yoni and CJE students and parents; interactive concert and drash at 11:30 AM; Ruach Rally at noon with Yoni, Cantor Sarah and the Ruach Rally Band. Dinner RSVP: https://bit.ly/cshsephardicshabbat26
